title: ThreatLens — Reconstruct the Invisible
desc: A browser-based SOC dashboard that reconstructs multi-stage cyber attacks by mapping security events across the Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK. Features a client-side rule engine that correlates raw telemetry, assigns dynamic threat scores, and enriches indicators of compromise without external backend dependencies.
tech: TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind CSS v4 · Cyber Kill Chain · MITRE ATT&CK

title: PromptShield — LLM Security Gateway
desc: An AI-powered defensive security gateway that protects Large Language Models against prompt injection, unauthorized tool execution, and sensitive data leakage. Deployed with real-time payload filtering and automated policy compliance on Azure cloud infrastructure.
tech: Python · FastAPI · Scikit-learn · Gemini API · Docker · Azure Container Apps

title: CyberTwin — AI Attack Surface & Blast Radius Engine
desc: An AI-powered Cyber Digital Twin platform for enterprise attack surface mapping, graph-based attack path analysis, blast radius calculation, vulnerability intelligence, and proactive threat exposure management.
tech: JavaScript · Graph Analysis · Threat Exposure Management · MIT License

title: Password Security Analyzer
desc: A real-time password strength analysis tool that evaluates security using Shannon entropy calculation, pattern detection, and common dictionary checks. Evaluates estimated crack time with zero external network telemetry.
tech: JavaScript · Python · HTML/CSS · Zxcvbn · GitHub Pages
